assignments.name: output
assignments.value: Hello! I'm Dr. Sara Hegy's coaching assistant. Ask me about leadership, delegation, accountability or giving difficult feedback, and I'll answer from documented coaching frameworks.

parameters.query:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT $1::vector(1024) AS v
),
frameworks AS (
  SELECT kv.session_id, kv.stream_type, kv.chunk_index, kv.content, kv.metadata,
         1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v) AS similarity
  FROM knowledge_vault kv, q
  WHERE kv.stream_type = 'framework'
    AND 1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v) >= 0.50  -- framework gate
  ORDER BY kv.embedding <=> q.v
  LIMIT 2
),
voice_samples AS (
  SELECT kv.session_id, kv.stream_type, kv.chunk_index, kv.content, kv.metadata,
         1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v) AS similarity
  FROM knowledge_vault kv, q
  WHERE kv.stream_type = 'voice_sample'
    AND 1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v) >= 0.50  -- voice_sample gate
  ORDER BY kv.embedding <=> q.v
  LIMIT 2
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(f ORDER BY f.similarity DESC) FROM frameworks f), '[]'::jsonb)    AS frameworks,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v.similarity DESC) FROM voice_samples v), '[]'::jsonb) AS voice_samples,
  (SELECT round(max(1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v))::numeric, 4) FROM knowledge_vault kv, q
     WHERE kv.stream_type = 'framework')    AS best_framework_similarity,
  (SELECT round(max(1 - (kv.embedding <=> q.v))::numeric, 4) FROM knowledge_vault kv, q
     WHERE kv.stream_type = 'voice_sample') AS best_voice_similarity;
